title: Feature
description: Something a character gains from a class, a subclass, a species, a background, a feat or an item. One model for all of them, because they differ only in where they come from, which `source` records. The 5e SRD keeps class features and species traits in separate collections; both land here.

from.description: The class, species, background or feat that grants it.

level.description: The level at which it is gained, for a class feature.

prerequisites.description: What must be true before it can be taken.

ability.description: The ability whose modifier sets the count, where it does.

uses.description: How often it can be used.
